blocks.text: ROXAS, Isabela – Police officers from various units in Isabela unearthed an alleged arms cache and found bullets, explosives and other war materiel in Barangay Sinamar in Roxas town on November 3. A rebel returnee tipped off the police about the buried weapons. READ: Police recover arms cache in Cagayan forest Found buried were two pails containing two M76 rifle grenades, two corroded 40mm high-explosive cartridges, two blasting caps, a 24-inch fuse, flash powder, three anti-personnel mines, eight 12-gauge cartridges, assorted bullets and other materials for making improvised explosives.
